complicated.usageZh: 形容词，指关系、问题、手续等头绪多。动词 complicate；名词 complication。反义 simple / straightforward。不能用 very more complicated。

examples.sentence: This lock is complicated.
examples.trans: 这把锁很复杂。

examples.sentence: Their weekend plan became complicated after the rain.
examples.trans: 下雨后他们的周末计划变复杂了。

examples.sentence: The family timetable grew complicated when both parents worked nights.
examples.trans: 父母都上夜班后，家里的时间表变复杂了。

examples.sentence: A complicated affection is still affection; it just needs slower language.
examples.trans: 复杂的感情仍是感情，只是需要更慢的语言。

examples.sentence: What looked like a complicated breakup was mostly two calendars that never met.
examples.trans: 看似复杂的分手，多半是两份从不相遇的日历。

examples.sentence: Policies that call a household complicated often mean they refuse to fund the missing hour.
examples.trans: 把一个家庭称为复杂的政策，往往是拒绝资助那缺少的一小时。

declared.usageZh: 及物动词：正式宣布 declared a holiday / declared that...。名词 declaration；形容词 declared（公开的）。过去式 declared。

examples.sentence: Dad declared a pancake morning.
examples.trans: 爸爸宣布今天早上摊饼。

examples.sentence: The mayor declared Friday a rest day.
examples.trans: 市长宣布周五休息。

examples.sentence: She declared that the argument was over and opened the windows.
examples.trans: 她宣布争吵结束，并打开了窗。

examples.sentence: A declared commitment means little if the calendar does not change.
examples.trans: 公开的承诺若日历不变，就没有多少意义。

examples.sentence: They declared the basement off-limits after the leak.
examples.trans: 漏水后他们宣布地下室不得进入。

examples.sentence: What was declared equal on paper still waited for the bus that never came.
examples.trans: 纸上宣布平等的事物，仍在等一辆从未来过的公交车。

statistics.usageZh: 名词，常用复数 statistics 统计数据；单数 statistic 一项统计。形容词 statistical；副词 statistically。与 data 近义但更强调整理后的数字。

examples.sentence: These statistics show more rainy days.
examples.trans: 这些统计显示雨天更多。

examples.sentence: Class statistics say most of us walk to school.
examples.trans: 班级统计说我们多数走路上学。

examples.sentence: The statistics on breakups rose after the long indoor months.
examples.trans: 漫长的室内月份之后，分手统计上升了。

examples.sentence: Statistics without names can hide who did the unpaid work.
examples.trans: 没有名字的统计，可能藏起谁做了无酬的工作。

examples.sentence: A single statistic about 'happy households' cannot carry a street of different kitchens.
examples.trans: 一个关于“幸福家庭”的统计，撑不起一整条街不同的厨房。

examples.sentence: Statistically rare suffering is still suffering when it sits at your table.
examples.trans: 统计上罕见的痛苦，坐在你桌边时仍是痛苦。

admitted.usageZh: admit 的过去式：承认 admitted a mistake / admitted that...。也可 admit sb to hospital。名词 admission。介词 admit to doing。

examples.sentence: Mia admitted she ate the last bun.
examples.trans: 米娅承认她吃了最后一个包子。

examples.sentence: He admitted the mistake and washed the cup.
examples.trans: 他承认了错误，把杯子洗了。

examples.sentence: They admitted that the silence in the flat had grown heavy.
examples.trans: 他们承认公寓里的沉默变重了。

examples.sentence: She admitted to judging the neighbours by their noise, not their care.
examples.trans: 她承认自己凭噪声而不是关心来评判邻居。

examples.sentence: The report admitted gaps in support for night-shift parents.
examples.trans: 报告承认对夜班父母的支持有缺口。

examples.sentence: What a government admits in a footnote often matters more than the headline.
examples.trans: 政府在脚注里承认的，往往比标题更重要。

doubt.usageZh: 可作名词 no doubt / in doubt / without doubt；动词 doubt whether/that。形容词 doubtful；副词 undoubtedly。

examples.sentence: I have no doubt you can finish it.
examples.trans: 我毫不怀疑你能做完。

examples.sentence: She began to doubt the weather app after three wrong mornings.
examples.trans: 错了三个早晨后，她开始怀疑天气应用。

examples.sentence: There is little doubt that locked doors changed family tempers.
examples.trans: 几乎无疑，锁上的门改变了家里的脾气。

examples.sentence: Doubt can be a form of care when it asks a better question.
examples.trans: 怀疑若能问出更好的问题，也可以是一种关心。

examples.sentence: He doubted whether 'just talk it out' worked without sleep.
examples.trans: 他怀疑在没有睡眠时，“好好谈谈”是否管用。

examples.sentence: Public doubt grows when statistics are published without the kitchens behind them.
examples.trans: 统计公布却不见背后的厨房时，公众的怀疑会增长。

breakups.usageZh: 可数名词复数：恋爱/关系结束。单数 breakup / break-up。短语动词 break up with。动词 break up。

examples.sentence: Two breakups in the story made her sad.
examples.trans: 故事里的两次分手让她难过。

examples.sentence: After the breakup he walked the long way home.
examples.trans: 分手后他走了很长的回家路。

examples.sentence: Indoor months did not cause every breakup, but they hurried some.
examples.trans: 室内的月份并不造成每一次分手，但催促了其中一些。

examples.sentence: A breakup can be a kindness when staying would be theatre.
examples.trans: 若留下只是演戏，分手也可以是一种善意。

examples.sentence: Therapists saw more breakups that were really arguments about dishes and time.
examples.trans: 治疗师看到更多分手其实是关于碗碟和时间的争吵。

examples.sentence: Statistics of breakups flatten the hour when someone first stopped being heard.
examples.trans: 分手统计会压平那个人第一次不再被听见的那个小时。

annoying.usageZh: 形容词：恼人的。动词 annoy；名词 annoyance。人感到恼火用 annoyed（人作主语），事物 annoying。

examples.sentence: The dripping tap is annoying.
examples.trans: 水龙头滴水很烦人。

examples.sentence: His loud humming became annoying in the small kitchen.
examples.trans: 在小厨房里，他大声哼歌变得烦人。

examples.sentence: The most annoying part was not the noise but the ignored message.
examples.trans: 最烦人的不是噪声，而是被无视的留言。

examples.sentence: An annoying habit can be a request that never found words.
examples.trans: 烦人的习惯，可能是一句从未找到词语的请求。

examples.sentence: She was more annoyed than the dripping deserved, which told her she was tired.
examples.trans: 她比那滴水应得的更恼火，这说明她累了。

examples.sentence: What a city calls annoying street life is often how neighbours keep watch.
examples.trans: 一座城市称为烦人的街头生活，往往是邻居互相照看的方式。

disagreements.usageZh: 可数名词：意见不合。单数 disagreement。动词 disagree；形容词 disagreeable（不悦的，词义不同）。have a disagreement about/over。

examples.sentence: They had a small disagreement about the TV.
examples.trans: 他们为电视有过小小争执。

examples.sentence: Most disagreements in the house started after ten o'clock.
examples.trans: 家里多数争执从十点以后开始。

examples.sentence: Honest disagreements can keep a family from pretending.
examples.trans: 诚实的分歧能让家庭不必装下去。

examples.sentence: A disagreement about money is often a disagreement about fear.
examples.trans: 关于钱的分歧，常常是关于恐惧的分歧。

examples.sentence: They learned to pause disagreements until both had eaten.
examples.trans: 他们学会把争执暂停到双方都吃过饭。

examples.sentence: Public disagreements are cheaper than silent ones that later explode in court.
examples.trans: 公开的分歧，比日后在法庭爆炸的沉默更便宜。

uncertainty.usageZh: 不可数名词：不确定。形容词 uncertain；副词 uncertainly。反义 certainty。live with uncertainty。

examples.sentence: The weather filled the picnic with uncertainty.
examples.trans: 天气让野餐充满不确定。

examples.sentence: She hated the uncertainty of waiting for a call.
examples.trans: 她讨厌等电话时的不确定。

examples.sentence: Job uncertainty made every small bill look larger.
examples.trans: 工作上的不确定让每张小账单都显得更大。

examples.sentence: Uncertainty in a house is louder than shouting if nobody names it.
examples.trans: 若没人说破，家里的不确定比喊叫更响。

examples.sentence: They planned two dinners because uncertainty had become a guest.
examples.trans: 他们准备了两顿晚饭，因为不确定已经成了客人。

examples.sentence: A government that sells certainty while funding nothing is selling a poster.
examples.trans: 一边贩卖确定一边什么都不资助的政府，是在卖一张海报。

stress.usageZh: 不可数名词：压力 under stress；动词 stress 强调。形容词 stressful / stressed。stress on a syllable 为重音，另一义。

examples.sentence: Too much noise gives me stress.
examples.trans: 太多噪声给我压力。

examples.sentence: Exam week is full of stress and late lamps.
examples.trans: 考试周充满压力和很晚的灯。

examples.sentence: Family stress rose when four people shared one small table.
examples.trans: 四个人共用一张小桌时，家庭压力上升了。

examples.sentence: Stress that cannot leave the body turns into a short temper.
examples.trans: 无法离开身体的压力会变成急脾气。

examples.sentence: She stressed that sleep was not a luxury in that flat.
examples.trans: 她强调在那套公寓里睡眠不是奢侈品。

examples.sentence: Public health posters that ignore unpaid labour will not reduce household stress.
examples.trans: 忽视无酬劳动的公卫海报，减不了家庭压力。

physical.usageZh: 形容词：身体的、物质的 physical health / physical work。副词 physically。名词 physics 物理（词义不同）。反义 mental。

examples.sentence: Running is a physical activity.
examples.trans: 跑步是身体活动。

examples.sentence: He felt a physical tiredness after carrying the water.
examples.trans: 他提完水后感到身体上的疲惫。

examples.sentence: Physical closeness in a small flat can be kindness or pressure.
examples.trans: 小公寓里的身体近距离，可以是善意也可以是压力。

examples.sentence: A physical symptom is sometimes the only language stress has left.
examples.trans: 身体症状有时是压力剩下的唯一语言。

examples.sentence: The clinic asked about physical pain before it asked about the locked months.
examples.trans: 诊所先问身体疼痛，再问那些锁门的月份。

examples.sentence: Physical equality of doors does not equal equal hours behind them.
examples.trans: 门在身体尺寸上的平等，不等于门后时间的平等。

understanding.usageZh: 不可数名词：理解、谅解 reach an understanding。形容词 understanding 善解人意。动词 understand。come to an understanding。

examples.sentence: Thank you for your understanding.
examples.trans: 谢谢你的理解。

examples.sentence: They reached an understanding about the TV volume.
examples.trans: 他们就电视音量达成了谅解。

examples.sentence: Understanding grew after they cooked on alternate nights.
examples.trans: 他们隔夜做饭之后，理解增加了。

examples.sentence: An understanding that never costs anyone time is only a slogan.
examples.trans: 从不花费任何人时间的理解，只是口号。

examples.sentence: She wanted an understanding neighbour more than a perfect one.
examples.trans: 她想要一个能理解的邻居，胜过一个完美的。

examples.sentence: Public understanding of care work still lags behind the statistics of who does it.
examples.trans: 公众对照护工作的理解，仍落后于“谁在做”的统计。

therapist.usageZh: 可数名词：治疗师 a family therapist。名词 therapy；形容词 therapeutic。相关 psychologist, counsellor。

examples.sentence: The therapist listened without rushing.
examples.trans: 治疗师不催促地听着。

examples.sentence: She booked a therapist after the third sleepless week.
examples.trans: 第三个失眠周后，她预约了治疗师。

examples.sentence: A good therapist treats the room, not only the loudest person.
examples.trans: 好的治疗师处理的是整个房间，而不只是最响的那个人。

examples.sentence: Therapists cannot replace a bus that never came, but they can name the wait.
examples.trans: 治疗师替代不了从未来过的公交车，但能给等待命名。

examples.sentence: The family therapist asked who did the dishes before asking who was angry.
examples.trans: 家庭治疗师先问谁洗碗，再问谁在生气。

examples.sentence: When therapy is a luxury, isolation becomes the default public service.
examples.trans: 当治疗成了奢侈品，隔离就变成默认的公共服务。

overcome.usageZh: 及物动词：克服 overcome fear/difficulty。过去式 overcame，过去分词 overcome。名词较少用 overcomer。

examples.sentence: She overcame her fear of the dark hall.
examples.trans: 她克服了对黑暗走廊的害怕。

examples.sentence: They overcame the argument by writing notes instead of shouting.
examples.trans: 他们用写纸条代替喊叫，克服了争吵。

examples.sentence: He has not yet overcome the jealousy that woke at midnight.
examples.trans: 他还没克服午夜醒来的嫉妒。

examples.sentence: To overcome isolation you sometimes need a door that opens both ways.
examples.trans: 要克服隔离，有时需要一扇双向开的门。

examples.sentence: The team overcame uncertainty by publishing the raw numbers.
examples.trans: 团队公布原始数字，克服了不确定。

examples.sentence: What cannot be overcome by willpower is often a missing hour of sleep or money.
examples.trans: 意志克服不了的，往往是缺少的一小时睡眠或钱。

jealous.usageZh: 形容词：嫉妒的 be jealous of sb/sth。名词 jealousy；副词 jealously。近义 envious（羡多于恨）。

examples.sentence: The puppy is jealous of the new toy.
examples.trans: 小狗嫉妒那个新玩具。

examples.sentence: He felt jealous when his sister got the window seat.
examples.trans: 妹妹坐了靠窗座位，他感到嫉妒。

examples.sentence: Jealous hours in a small flat often start as fear of being left out.
examples.trans: 小公寓里的嫉妒时刻，往往始于害怕被排除。

examples.sentence: A jealous silence can do more damage than a loud sentence.
examples.trans: 嫉妒的沉默可能比一句大声的话伤害更大。

examples.sentence: She was jealous of the neighbour's unbroken sleep, not the neighbour's money.
examples.trans: 她嫉妒的是邻居未被打断的睡眠，不是邻居的钱。

examples.sentence: Jealousy dressed as a joke still asks to be counted.
examples.trans: 打扮成笑话的嫉妒，仍要求被计算进去。

isolation.usageZh: 不可数名词：隔离、孤独 isolation from。动词 isolate；形容词 isolated。反义 connection, company。

examples.sentence: The snow brought a kind of isolation.
examples.trans: 雪带来一种隔离。

examples.sentence: Isolation made the small noises in the pipes seem louder.
examples.trans: 隔离让水管里的小声音显得更响。

examples.sentence: They fought isolation with evening calls to cousins.
examples.trans: 他们用晚上给表亲打电话来对抗隔离。

examples.sentence: Isolation is not always empty; sometimes it is full of unfinished arguments.
examples.trans: 隔离不一定是空的；有时装满未完成的争执。

examples.sentence: An isolated parent can still be surrounded by people who do not help.
examples.trans: 被孤立的父母仍可能被不帮忙的人包围。

examples.sentence: Public isolation during lockdowns revealed which work had never been shared.
examples.trans: 封锁期间的公共隔离，揭示了哪些工作从未被分担。

communication.usageZh: 不可数名词为主：交流 communication with/between。动词 communicate；形容词 communicative。communication skills。

examples.sentence: Good communication starts with listening.
examples.trans: 好的交流从倾听开始。

examples.sentence: Their communication improved when they sat at the same table.
examples.trans: 他们坐到同一张桌后，交流改善了。

examples.sentence: Communication failed not from lack of words but from lack of pauses.
examples.trans: 交流失败不是因为缺词，而是因为缺少停顿。

examples.sentence: Household communication is also who texts first after a slammed door.
examples.trans: 家庭交流也包括摔门之后谁先发消息。

examples.sentence: Clear communication about night shifts prevented two useless dinners.
examples.trans: 关于夜班的清楚交流避免了两顿白做的晚饭。

examples.sentence: National communication that never mentions unpaid hours will not heal private rooms.
examples.trans: 从不提及无酬时数的国家话语，治愈不了私人房间。

incredibly.usageZh: 副词：极其、难以置信地 incredibly tired/kind。形容词 incredible；名词 incredulity。口语强化语，书面可改 extremely。

examples.sentence: The soup is incredibly hot.
examples.trans: 这汤烫得惊人。

examples.sentence: She was incredibly tired after the night feed.
examples.trans: 夜喂之后她累得不可思议。

examples.sentence: It was incredibly quiet once the argument ended.
examples.trans: 争吵结束后安静得出奇。

examples.sentence: An incredibly neat statistic may be a rounded-off kitchen.
examples.trans: 整齐得不可思议的统计，可能是被抹圆的厨房。

examples.sentence: They were incredibly careful with each other's sleep.
examples.trans: 他们对彼此的睡眠小心得惊人。

examples.sentence: Incredibly patient policies still fail if they arrive after the breakup.
examples.trans: 即便耐心得惊人的政策，若在分手之后才到，仍会失败。

frighten.usageZh: 及物动词：使害怕 frighten sb。形容词 frightened（人）/ frightening（事物）。名词 fright。

examples.sentence: Thunder can frighten the cat.
examples.trans: 雷声会吓到猫。

examples.sentence: The sudden silence frightened him more than the shout.
examples.trans: 突然的沉默比喊叫更让他害怕。

examples.sentence: Do not frighten the child with a locked-room joke.
examples.trans: 不要用锁房的笑话吓唬孩子。

examples.sentence: Uncertainty can frighten a household into cruel small rules.
examples.trans: 不确定会把一个家庭吓进残酷的小规则。

examples.sentence: She was frightened, not angry, which changed how he listened.
examples.trans: 她是害怕不是生气，这改变了他听的方式。

examples.sentence: What frightens a city in a headline may be ordinary in a kitchen.
examples.trans: 标题里吓到一座城的事，在厨房里可能很平常。

equality.usageZh: 不可数名词：平等 equality of/between。形容词 equal；副词 equally。反义 inequality。racial/gender equality。

examples.sentence: They split the fruit in equality.
examples.trans: 他们把水果平等地分了。

examples.sentence: Equality at the table means everyone gets a chair that fits.
examples.trans: 桌上的平等意味着每个人都有合适的椅子。

examples.sentence: Talk of equality sounds thin if one person always washes up.
examples.trans: 若总是同一个人洗碗，谈平等就显得薄。

examples.sentence: Equality is not sameness; it is a fair share of the heavy hours.
examples.trans: 平等不是相同，而是沉重钟点的公平分担。

examples.sentence: The school taught equality while the bus map still skipped one hill.
examples.trans: 学校教平等，公交图却仍跳过一座山。

examples.sentence: Legal equality without funded care leaves kitchens to finish the job unpaid.
examples.trans: 没有资助照护的法律平等，把活留给厨房无偿做完。

inequality.usageZh: 不可数或可数：不平等 inequality in/of。形容词 unequal。social/income inequality。

examples.sentence: Sharing one bun with inequality made her frown.
examples.trans: 不均地分一个包子让她皱眉。

examples.sentence: Pay inequality showed up in who could take a sick day.
examples.trans: 薪酬不平等显现在谁能请病假。

examples.sentence: Indoor months made old inequalities louder, not new.
examples.trans: 室内的月份让旧的不平等更响，而不是新造出来。

examples.sentence: Inequality often hides in the person who is 'just better at noticing mess'.
examples.trans: 不平等常藏在那个“就是更会发现脏乱”的人身上。

examples.sentence: They measured inequality not only in money but in interrupted sleep.
examples.trans: 他们衡量不平等，不只用钱，也用被打断的睡眠。

examples.sentence: A statistic of average happiness can be an instrument of inequality.
examples.trans: 平均幸福的统计，可以成为不平等的工具。

respectful.usageZh: 形容词：有礼貌、尊重的 be respectful to/of sb。名词 respect；副词 respectfully。反义 disrespectful。

examples.sentence: Be respectful when someone is sleeping.
examples.trans: 有人睡觉时请保持尊重。

examples.sentence: A respectful voice can still disagree.
examples.trans: 尊重的声音仍然可以不同意。

examples.sentence: They stayed respectful during the disagreement about money.
examples.trans: 关于钱的争执中，他们仍保持尊重。

examples.sentence: Respectful language without respectful hours is decoration.
examples.trans: 没有尊重的时间，尊重的语言只是装饰。

examples.sentence: He asked, respectfully, who had eaten and who had only served.
examples.trans: 他恭敬地问，谁吃了，谁只是端菜。

examples.sentence: A respectful public poster cannot replace a respectful timetable.
examples.trans: 一张尊重的公海报替代不了一张尊重的时间表。

background.usageZh: 可数名词：背景 family/educational background；也可指幕后 on the background。形容词 background（作定语）。

examples.sentence: Her family background is a small coastal town.
examples.trans: 她的家庭背景是一座海边小城。

examples.sentence: Students from different backgrounds shared one table.
examples.trans: 不同背景的学生共用一张桌子。

examples.sentence: A noisy background made the call harder than the argument.
examples.trans: 嘈杂的背景让电话比争吵更难。

examples.sentence: Background is not destiny, but it is a set of unpaid lessons.
examples.trans: 背景不是命运，而是一套未付费的课。

examples.sentence: Judging a household by background skips the night-shift maths.
examples.trans: 凭背景评判一个家庭，会跳过夜班的算术。

examples.sentence: Policy written against one background will fail another kitchen.
examples.trans: 按一种背景写的政策，会在另一间厨房失败。

generation.usageZh: 可数名词：一代 generation of；the younger generation。形容词 generational。generation gap 代沟。

examples.sentence: This generation likes night markets.
examples.trans: 这一代人喜欢夜市。

examples.sentence: Three generations cooked in the same small kitchen.
examples.trans: 三代人在同一间小厨房做饭。

examples.sentence: A generation raised behind locked doors still remembers the key sound.
examples.trans: 在锁门后长大的一代仍记得钥匙的声音。

examples.sentence: Generational care is often women passing tiredness downward.
examples.trans: 代际照护常常是女性把疲惫往下传。

examples.sentence: The younger generation asked why 'tradition' always meant their silence.
examples.trans: 年轻一代问，为什么“传统”总意味着他们的沉默。

examples.sentence: A generation gap can be a timetable gap dressed as taste.
examples.trans: 代沟可以是打扮成品味的时间表鸿沟。

unacceptable.usageZh: 形容词：不能接受的。反义 acceptable。动词 accept；名词 acceptance。un- 为否定前缀。

examples.sentence: Throwing food is unacceptable here.
examples.trans: 在这里扔食物不可接受。

examples.sentence: Shouting at night is unacceptable in this thin building.
examples.trans: 在这栋隔音很差的楼里，夜里喊叫不可接受。

examples.sentence: They called the unpaid extra shift unacceptable and wrote it down.
examples.trans: 他们称无偿加班不可接受，并写了下来。

examples.sentence: What is unacceptable in a poster may still be normal in a kitchen.
examples.trans: 海报上不可接受的，在厨房里仍可能是常态。

examples.sentence: The union named the delay unacceptable after the third broken promise.
examples.trans: 第三次食言后，工会称延误不可接受。

examples.sentence: An unacceptable inequality does not become culture by lasting long enough.
examples.trans: 不可接受的不平等，不会因为持续够久就变成文化。

judging.usageZh: judge 的现在分词/动名词：评判 judging by / judging from。名词 judgment/judgement；形容词 judgmental。

examples.sentence: Stop judging the cat for sleeping all day.
examples.trans: 别因为猫整天睡就评判它。

examples.sentence: Judging by the shoes, they had walked far.
examples.trans: 从鞋子看，他们走了很远。

examples.sentence: She caught herself judging the neighbours by their noise.
examples.trans: 她发现自己凭噪声在评判邻居。

examples.sentence: Judging a household by its living room skips the night-shift parent.
examples.trans: 凭客厅评判一个家庭，会漏掉上夜班的父母。

examples.sentence: A judgmental joke at dinner can reopen a closed disagreement.
examples.trans: 晚餐时爱评判的笑话，能重新打开已结束的争执。

examples.sentence: Public judging of 'broken families' rarely counts who was left holding the timetable.
examples.trans: 公众对“破碎家庭”的评判，很少计算谁手里还握着时间表。

responsible.usageZh: 形容词：负责的 be responsible for sth；名词 responsibility；副词 responsibly。反义 irresponsible。

examples.sentence: You are responsible for your own cup.
examples.trans: 你负责自己的杯子。

examples.sentence: Who is responsible for locking the door tonight?
examples.trans: 今晚谁负责锁门？

examples.sentence: Being responsible for a child is also being responsible for your own sleep.
examples.trans: 对孩子负责，也包括对自己的睡眠负责。

examples.sentence: Responsible talk names the task, not a personality flaw.
examples.trans: 负责任的谈话点名的是任务，不是性格缺陷。

examples.sentence: They shared responsible hours instead of one person being 'naturally better at it'.
examples.trans: 他们分担负责的钟点，而不是让一个人“天生更擅长”。

examples.sentence: A responsible government funds the care it praises on posters.
examples.trans: 负责任的政府会资助它在海报上赞美的照护。

peaceful.usageZh: 形容词：和平的、安静的 a peaceful evening。名词 peace；副词 peacefully。反义 noisy / violent。

examples.sentence: The lake looks peaceful at dawn.
examples.trans: 黎明时湖面很平静。

examples.sentence: They wanted a peaceful dinner after the long day.
examples.trans: 漫长的一天后他们想要一顿安静的晚饭。

examples.sentence: A peaceful house is not a silent one; it is a fair one.
examples.trans: 安宁的房子不是无声的，而是公平的。

examples.sentence: Peaceful slogans fail when the night shift still eats alone.
examples.trans: 夜班仍独自吃饭时，和平口号会失败。

examples.sentence: The street was peaceful until the trucks returned at four.
examples.trans: 街道一直安宁，直到四点卡车回来。

examples.sentence: Peaceful coexistence in a flat requires a timetable, not only manners.
examples.trans: 公寓里的和平共处需要时间表，而不只是礼貌。

trust.usageZh: 不可数名词：信任 trust in sb；动词 trust sb to do。形容词 trusting / trustworthy。lose/gain/earn trust。

examples.sentence: I trust you with the key.
examples.trans: 我把钥匙交给你。

examples.sentence: Trust grew after they kept the small promises.
examples.trans: 他们守住小承诺后，信任增长了。

examples.sentence: Without trust, every late bus looks like a lie.
examples.trans: 没有信任，每班晚点的车都像谎言。

examples.sentence: Trust is built in the hour someone returns with bread as promised.
examples.trans: 信任建在有人如约带着面包回来的那个小时。

examples.sentence: She could not trust a smile that never helped with the dishes.
examples.trans: 她无法信任一个从不帮忙洗碗的微笑。

examples.sentence: Public trust thins when equality is declared and the bus map stays the same.
examples.trans: 宣布平等而公交图不变时，公众信任会变薄。

government.usageZh: 可数名词：政府 the government；形容词 governmental。动词 govern。local/national government。

examples.sentence: The government planted new trees.
examples.trans: 政府种了新树。

examples.sentence: Local government opened the hall during the storm.
examples.trans: 地方政府在暴风雨期间开放了礼堂。

examples.sentence: The government declared rest days that workers still could not take.
examples.trans: 政府宣布了工人仍无法享用的休息日。

examples.sentence: A government is judged by whose hours it buys back.
examples.trans: 评判政府，要看它买回了谁的时间。

examples.sentence: They wrote to the government about the missing night bus.
examples.trans: 他们就缺失的夜班车给政府写信。

examples.sentence: Government praise for families means little without funded hours of care.
examples.trans: 没有资助的照护时数，政府对家庭的赞美意义不大。

suffered.usageZh: suffer 的过去式：受苦 suffered from cold/illness；也可 suffer a loss。名词 suffering / sufferer。

examples.sentence: The plants suffered in the heat.
examples.trans: 植物在高温中受苦。

examples.sentence: He suffered from headaches after the noisy weeks.
examples.trans: 嘈杂的几周后他头痛。

examples.sentence: Many households suffered isolation that statistics called 'staying home'.
examples.trans: 许多家庭遭受的隔离，统计称为“待在家里”。

examples.sentence: They suffered a quiet loss: the evening walk they used to share.
examples.trans: 他们遭受一种安静的损失：曾经一起走的晚间散步。

examples.sentence: Those who suffered most were already short of rooms and hours.
examples.trans: 受苦最多的人，本来就缺少房间和钟点。

examples.sentence: A city that has suffered together may still refuse to share the bill equally.
examples.trans: 一同受过苦的城市，仍可能拒绝平等分担账单。

depressed.usageZh: 形容词：沮丧的、抑郁的 feel depressed。名词 depression；动词 depress。clinical 义需谨慎、尊重。

examples.sentence: The grey rain made her feel depressed.
examples.trans: 灰蒙蒙的雨让她心情低落。

examples.sentence: He looked depressed after another cancelled visit.
examples.trans: 又一次探访取消后，他显得沮丧。

examples.sentence: Locked months left some neighbours quietly depressed.
examples.trans: 锁门的月份让一些邻居悄悄抑郁。

examples.sentence: A depressed silence is not laziness; it is a body asking for help.
examples.trans: 抑郁的沉默不是懒，是身体在求助。

examples.sentence: They treated the depressed weeks as weather, then as something to name.
examples.trans: 他们先把抑郁的几周当天气，后来当成需要命名的事。

examples.sentence: Public talk that shames the depressed will not shorten a waiting list.
examples.trans: 羞辱抑郁者的公共话语，缩短不了等候名单。

contribution.usageZh: 可数名词：贡献 make a contribution to。动词 contribute；形容词 contributory。financial contribution。

examples.sentence: Everyone made a contribution to the soup.
examples.trans: 每个人都为这锅汤出了力。

examples.sentence: Her contribution was the quiet hour of washing up.
examples.trans: 她的贡献是安静洗碗的那一小时。

examples.sentence: Unpaid contributions keep a household standing and vanish from statistics.
examples.trans: 无偿贡献撑起家庭，却从统计里消失。

examples.sentence: A contribution that cannot be listed on a form is still a contribution.
examples.trans: 表格上列不出的贡献，仍是贡献。

examples.sentence: They asked whose contribution was being called 'just helping out'.
examples.trans: 他们问，谁的贡献被叫做“只是帮忙”。

examples.sentence: National wealth is a pile of unnamed contributions plus a few famous names.
examples.trans: 国家财富是一堆未命名的贡献，外加几个名人。

limit.usageZh: 可数名词：限度 a time limit；动词 limit sth to。形容词 limited；介词 within limits。

examples.sentence: There is a time limit for the game.
examples.trans: 游戏有时间限制。

examples.sentence: They set a limit on shouting after nine.
examples.trans: 他们规定九点后不许喊叫。

examples.sentence: Patience has a limit when sleep has already been spent.
examples.trans: 睡眠已经花光时，耐心是有限度的。

examples.sentence: A limit on night buses is a limit on who can work and still get home.
examples.trans: 限制夜班车，就是限制谁能工作还能回家。

examples.sentence: She limited her advice to what she was willing to help with.
examples.trans: 她把建议限制在自己愿意帮忙的范围内。

examples.sentence: Rights without funded limits on unpaid hours remain speeches.
examples.trans: 若对无偿时数没有资助性的限制，权利就仍是演讲。

fundamental.usageZh: 形容词：根本的 fundamental right/change。名词 fundamentals。副词 fundamentally。近义 basic, essential。

examples.sentence: Sleep is a fundamental need.
examples.trans: 睡眠是根本需要。

examples.sentence: Fairness is fundamental in a shared kitchen.
examples.trans: 公平是共用厨房的根本。

examples.sentence: A fundamental right to rest means little without a night bus.
examples.trans: 没有夜班车，休息的根本权利意义不大。

examples.sentence: They disagreed on details but shared a fundamental wish to stay.
examples.trans: 他们细节上有分歧，但有留下的根本愿望。

examples.sentence: Fundamental equality starts with who can be late without punishment.
examples.trans: 根本平等始于谁可以迟到而不受罚。

examples.sentence: What is called a fundamental value is often a timetable someone else keeps.
examples.trans: 所谓根本价值，常常是别人在维持的时间表。

expression.usageZh: 可数名词：表达、表情 facial expression；freedom of expression。动词 express；形容词 expressive。

examples.sentence: Her expression became soft when the baby slept.
examples.trans: 宝宝睡着时，她的表情变柔和了。

examples.sentence: He found an expression for the fear: too many people, too few rooms.
examples.trans: 他给恐惧找到了表达：人太多，房间太少。

examples.sentence: Freedom of expression includes the right to name unpaid work.
examples.trans: 表达自由包括给无偿工作命名的权利。

examples.sentence: A kind expression that never moves a dish is still only a face.
examples.trans: 从不挪动碗碟的和善表情，仍只是一张脸。

examples.sentence: Their songs became an expression of the locked months.
examples.trans: 他们的歌成了对锁门月份的表达。

examples.sentence: Legal expression of equality must survive contact with a kitchen clock.
examples.trans: 平等的法律表达，必须经得起厨房时钟的接触。

influence.usageZh: 可作名词 have an influence on；动词 influence sb/sth。形容词 influential。不可数或可数。

examples.sentence: Friends influence how we speak.
examples.trans: 朋友影响我们说话的方式。

examples.sentence: The locked months influenced family tempers.
examples.trans: 锁门的月份影响了家里的脾气。

examples.sentence: Night-shift pay has more influence than posters about love.
examples.trans: 夜班薪水比关于爱的海报更有影响力。

examples.sentence: An influence that cannot be refused is not advice; it is power.
examples.trans: 无法拒绝的影响不是建议，是权力。

examples.sentence: She influenced the meeting by asking who had eaten last.
examples.trans: 她通过问谁最后吃饭，影响了会议。

examples.sentence: Media influence on 'happy families' rarely shows the person washing up.
examples.trans: 媒体对“幸福家庭”的影响，很少露出那个洗碗的人。

wealthy.usageZh: 形容词：富有的 a wealthy street。名词 wealth；副词 wealthily 少用。近义 rich；反义 poor。

examples.sentence: The wealthy street has more trees.
examples.trans: 富裕的街道树更多。

examples.sentence: A wealthy cousin sent fruit during the locked weeks.
examples.trans: 富裕的表亲在锁门的几周送来水果。

examples.sentence: Wealthy households bought space; others bought patience.
examples.trans: 富裕家庭买空间；别人买耐心。

examples.sentence: Being wealthy does not cancel isolation, but it buys a door that opens.
examples.trans: 富裕取消不了隔离，但能买到一扇开得了的门。

examples.sentence: They were not wealthy, yet they were rich in neighbours who knocked.
examples.trans: 他们不富裕，却富有会敲门的邻居。

examples.sentence: A wealthy city's equality speech is tested at the last bus stop.
examples.trans: 富裕城市的平等演说，在末班车站接受检验。

went through.usageZh: 短语动词 go through 的过去式：经历困难 went through a hard year。也可 go through a bag 翻找。

examples.sentence: We went through a rainy week in the tent.
examples.trans: 我们在帐篷里过了下雨的一周。

examples.sentence: She went through three drafts of the apology.
examples.trans: 她把道歉改了三稿。

examples.sentence: The family went through locked months without a spare room.
examples.trans: 这家人在没有多余房间的情况下度过了锁门的月份。

examples.sentence: What they went through does not make them a statistic first.
examples.trans: 他们经历的事，不会首先把他们变成统计。

examples.sentence: He went through the bills twice before naming the fear.
examples.trans: 他在说出恐惧之前把账单翻了两遍。

examples.sentence: A city that has gone through a shared crisis still chooses who pays the quiet costs.
examples.trans: 经历过共同危机的城市，仍会选择谁来支付安静的代价。

keep in mind.usageZh: 动词短语：记住、考虑到 keep in mind that...。近义 bear in mind。名词 mind。

examples.sentence: Keep in mind the wet floor.
examples.trans: 记住地是湿的。

examples.sentence: Keep in mind that Grandpa sleeps after lunch.
examples.trans: 记住爷爷午饭后要睡。

examples.sentence: Keep in mind who cooked before you praise the peaceful house.
examples.trans: 在赞美安宁的家之前，记住是谁做的饭。

examples.sentence: Judges keep in mind the timetable, not only the raised voice.
examples.trans: 评判时要考虑时间表，而不只是提高的嗓门。

examples.sentence: Keep in mind that a late bus is a policy, not a personality.
examples.trans: 记住晚点的公交车是政策，不是性格。

examples.sentence: Good reports keep in mind the kitchens that statistics flatten.
examples.trans: 好的报告会记住被统计压平的那些厨房。

would rather.usageZh: 情态结构：宁愿 would rather do (than do)。否定 would rather not。主语不同用 would rather sb did。

examples.sentence: I would rather walk than wait.
examples.trans: 我宁愿走路也不愿等。

examples.sentence: She would rather wash up than argue.
examples.trans: 她宁愿洗碗也不愿吵。

examples.sentence: They would rather keep a small peace than win a loud point.
examples.trans: 他们宁愿维持小小的和平，也不愿赢下大声的一分。

examples.sentence: He would rather you slept than listened to his complaint.
examples.trans: 他宁愿你去睡，而不是听他抱怨。

examples.sentence: I would rather not measure love in who gives in first.
examples.trans: 我不愿用谁先让步来衡量爱。

examples.sentence: A tired city would rather post a slogan than fund the night bus.
examples.trans: 疲惫的城市宁愿贴口号，也不愿资助夜班车。

stand their ground.usageZh: 习语：坚持立场 stand one's ground。过去式 stood their ground。近义 hold one's ground。

examples.sentence: The small dog stood its ground at the gate.
examples.trans: 小狗在门口坚持不退。

examples.sentence: They stood their ground about the night-time quiet.
examples.trans: 他们在夜里安静这件事上不让步。

examples.sentence: She stood her ground: the extra shift would be paid or refused.
examples.trans: 她坚持立场：加班要么给钱要么拒绝。

examples.sentence: Standing your ground is not the same as refusing to hear.
examples.trans: 坚持立场不等于拒绝倾听。

examples.sentence: The union stood their ground until the rest days became real.
examples.trans: 工会坚持到休息日变成真的。

examples.sentence: Households that stand their ground on sleep are practising a politics of hours.
examples.trans: 在睡眠上坚持立场的家庭，是在实践一种关于钟点的政治。

come to a common understanding.usageZh: 动词短语：达成共识。也可 reach a common understanding。understanding 为名词。

examples.sentence: They came to a common understanding about the TV.
examples.trans: 他们就电视达成了共识。

examples.sentence: After soup, they came to a common understanding on chores.
examples.trans: 喝完汤，他们就家务达成了共识。

examples.sentence: A common understanding needs both calendars on the table.
examples.trans: 共同理解需要两份日历都放在桌上。

examples.sentence: They came to a common understanding: shouting after ten was off limits.
examples.trans: 他们达成共识：十点后不许喊。

examples.sentence: Coming to a common understanding is slower than winning.
examples.trans: 达成共识比赢更慢。

examples.sentence: Cities rarely come to a common understanding with the last bus stop.
examples.trans: 城市很少与末班车站达成共同理解。

live in peace.usageZh: 动词短语：和平地生活 live in peace with。名词 peace。副词 peacefully。

examples.sentence: The cats finally live in peace.
examples.trans: 猫们终于和平相处了。

examples.sentence: They wanted to live in peace after the long argument.
examples.trans: 长吵之后他们想平静地生活。

examples.sentence: To live in peace in a small flat you need a fair timetable.
examples.trans: 要在小公寓里平静生活，需要公平的时间表。

examples.sentence: Living in peace is not living in silence.
examples.trans: 平静生活不是沉默生活。

examples.sentence: Neighbours lived in peace until the trucks returned at four.
examples.trans: 邻居们一直平静，直到四点卡车回来。

examples.sentence: A right to live in peace includes a right not to do all the dishes.
examples.trans: 平静生活的权利，包括不必包揽所有碗碟的权利。

jealous of.usageZh: 形容词短语：嫉妒 be jealous of sb/sth。名词 jealousy。

examples.sentence: The dog is jealous of the baby.
examples.trans: 狗嫉妒宝宝。

examples.sentence: He was jealous of his brother's window seat.
examples.trans: 他嫉妒弟弟的靠窗座位。

examples.sentence: She felt jealous of the neighbour's unbroken night.
examples.trans: 她嫉妒邻居未被打断的夜晚。

examples.sentence: Being jealous of rest is a map of who lacks it.
examples.trans: 嫉妒休息，是一张谁缺少休息的地图。

examples.sentence: They were jealous of families with a spare room, not of love.
examples.trans: 他们嫉妒有空房的家庭，不是嫉妒爱。

examples.sentence: A politics jealous of other people's sleep will not fund care.
examples.trans: 嫉妒别人睡眠的政治，不会资助照护。

broke up with.usageZh: 短语动词过去式：与……分手 broke up with sb。现在 break up with。名词 breakup。

examples.sentence: He broke up with the team after the last match.
examples.trans: 最后一场比赛后他离开了队伍。

examples.sentence: She broke up with him during the locked months.
examples.trans: 锁门的月份里她和他分了手。

examples.sentence: They broke up with the old timetable, not with each other.
examples.trans: 他们甩掉的是旧时间表，不是彼此。

examples.sentence: Breaking up with a habit can feel like breaking up with a person.
examples.trans: 与习惯分手，感觉可能像与一个人分手。

examples.sentence: He broke up with the job that stole every Sunday.
examples.trans: 他离开了偷走每个星期天的那份工作。

examples.sentence: Statistics say more people broke up; kitchens say more people ran out of hours.
examples.trans: 统计说更多人分手了；厨房说更多人耗尽了钟点。

get over.usageZh: 短语动词：从……中恢复 get over a cold / a breakup。也可 get over a wall。过去 got over。

examples.sentence: She got over the cold in a week.
examples.trans: 她一周就从感冒里恢复了。

examples.sentence: It took him a month to get over the argument.
examples.trans: 他花了一个月才走出那场争吵。

examples.sentence: You do not get over isolation by pretending it was a holiday.
examples.trans: 把隔离假装成假期，走不出隔离。

examples.sentence: Getting over a breakup is slower when you still share a kitchen.
examples.trans: 仍共用厨房时，走出分手更慢。

examples.sentence: The city has not got over the trucks at four.
examples.trans: 这座城还没走出四点的卡车。

examples.sentence: Some losses you do not get over; you learn a longer way around them.
examples.trans: 有些损失走不出来；你只是学会绕更长的路。

on-line dating.usageZh: 名词短语：网上约会（也作 online dating）。dating 为动名词。hyphen 可有可无。

examples.sentence: On-line dating felt new to Grandpa.
examples.trans: 网上约会对爷爷来说很新。

examples.sentence: They met through on-line dating and then cooked together.
examples.trans: 他们通过网上约会认识，后来一起做饭。

examples.sentence: On-line dating during locked months was a door that still opened.
examples.trans: 锁门月份里的网上约会，是一扇仍能打开的门。

examples.sentence: On-line dating can skip the body and still collide with the timetable.
examples.trans: 网上约会可以跳过身体，仍会撞上时间表。

examples.sentence: She left on-line dating after too many profiles mentioned 'no drama' and meant 'no dishes'.
examples.trans: 太多资料写着“不要戏剧”却意味着“不要洗碗”，她退出了网上约会。

examples.sentence: A boom in on-line dating is also a map of rooms that could not hold two tempers.
examples.trans: 网上约会的热潮，也是一张装不下两种脾气的房间地图。

as equal as.usageZh: 同级比较：as equal as 一样平等（课文强调平等比较）。更常见 as equal as possible；也可 as + adj. + as。

examples.sentence: Share the fruit as equal as you can.
examples.trans: 尽你所能把水果分得一样多。

examples.sentence: They tried to be as equal as two different shifts allow.
examples.trans: 他们试图在两个不同班次允许的范围内尽量平等。

examples.sentence: No two nights are as equal as a poster claims.
examples.trans: 没有两个夜晚像海报宣称的那样平等。

examples.sentence: A law as equal as ink is still tested by a kitchen clock.
examples.trans: 和墨水一样平等的法律，仍要受厨房时钟检验。

examples.sentence: Make the chairs as equal as the table, not only the speeches.
examples.trans: 让椅子像桌子一样平等，而不只是演说。

examples.sentence: Rights as equal as paper still trip on the last bus.
examples.trans: 和纸一样平等的权利，仍会在末班车上绊倒。

came from.usageZh: come from 的过去式：来自 came from a town / came from a hard year。也可表出身。

examples.sentence: This apple came from Grandma's tree.
examples.trans: 这个苹果来自奶奶的树。

examples.sentence: The idea came from a late-night conversation.
examples.trans: 这想法来自一次深夜谈话。

examples.sentence: Their patience came from years of shared kitchens.
examples.trans: 他们的耐心来自多年共用的厨房。

examples.sentence: The anger came from unpaid hours, not from a loud personality.
examples.trans: 愤怒来自无偿时数，不是来自大声的性格。

examples.sentence: She came from a background where rest was a rumour.
examples.trans: 她来自一个把休息当成传闻的背景。

examples.sentence: What came from the locked months was a clearer map of who carried the house.
examples.trans: 锁门月份带来的，是一张更清晰的“谁撑着家”的地图。

according to.usageZh: 介词短语：根据 according to sb/sth。后接名词，不接 view 用 in my opinion。不要 according to me（口语有，考场少用）。

examples.sentence: According to the clock, it is dinner.
examples.trans: 根据时钟，该吃晚饭了。

examples.sentence: According to Dad, the bus is never on time.
examples.trans: 据爸爸说，公交车从不准时。

examples.sentence: According to the statistics, breakups rose; according to kitchens, hours vanished.
examples.trans: 据统计分手上升；据厨房说，钟点消失了。

examples.sentence: According to the poster, families are happy; according to the sink, someone is tired.
examples.trans: 据海报家庭很幸福；据水槽，有人累了。

examples.sentence: Pay them according to the hours actually worked, including the night ones.
examples.trans: 按实际工作的时数付钱，包括夜里的。

examples.sentence: According to the law they were equal; according to the last bus they were not.
examples.trans: 据法律他们平等；据末班车他们不是。

get rid of.usageZh: 短语动词：摆脱、去掉 get rid of sth/sb。过去 got rid of。近义 throw away（更具体）。

examples.sentence: Get rid of the dripping by tightening the tap.
examples.trans: 拧紧水龙头，去掉滴水。

examples.sentence: They got rid of the old timetable that punished one person.
examples.trans: 他们去掉了惩罚一个人的旧时间表。

examples.sentence: You cannot get rid of isolation with a slogan.
examples.trans: 用口号摆脱不了隔离。

examples.sentence: Get rid of the joke that calls unpaid work 'helping out'.
examples.trans: 去掉把无偿工作叫做“帮忙”的笑话。

examples.sentence: She got rid of the habit of judging by living-room noise.
examples.trans: 她改掉了凭客厅噪声评判的习惯。

examples.sentence: Cities try to get rid of 'annoying' street life and then miss their night watch.
examples.trans: 城市想去掉“烦人的”街头生活，然后怀念夜里的守望。

bring up.usageZh: 短语动词：养育 bring up a child；也可提出 bring up a topic。过去 brought up。名词 upbringing。

examples.sentence: Grandma helped bring up the twins.
examples.trans: 奶奶帮忙把双胞胎带大。

examples.sentence: They brought up the topic of night buses at dinner.
examples.trans: 晚饭时他们提起夜班车的话题。

examples.sentence: To bring up a child in a small flat is a timetable art.
examples.trans: 在小公寓里养孩子是一种时间表的艺术。

examples.sentence: She was brought up to treat rest as optional; she unlearned it.
examples.trans: 她被教育成把休息当可选项；她把它忘掉了。

examples.sentence: Bring up the unpaid hours before you bring up personality.
examples.trans: 在提起性格之前，先提起无偿时数。

examples.sentence: A generation brought up behind locked doors still knows the sound of a shared key.
examples.trans: 在锁门后长大的一代，仍认得共用钥匙的声音。

up to.usageZh: 介词短语：多达 up to ten people；由……决定 it's up to you；胜任 be up to the job。

examples.sentence: The lift holds up to six people.
examples.trans: 电梯最多载六人。

examples.sentence: It's up to you to lock the door.
examples.trans: 锁门由你决定。

examples.sentence: They can stay up to ten, then the house needs quiet.
examples.trans: 他们可以待到十点，然后家里需要安静。

examples.sentence: Whether the extra shift is taken is not only up to love.
examples.trans: 加不加班不只取决于爱。

examples.sentence: Sleep debt can pile up to a kind of weather in the rooms.
examples.trans: 睡眠债可以堆积成房间里的一种天气。

examples.sentence: Equality that is up to individual kindness will fail the tired.
examples.trans: 取决于个人善意的平等，会让疲惫的人失败。

fill the gap.usageZh: 动词短语：填补缺口 fill the gap (between/in)。名词 gap。也可 fill a gap in the market。

examples.sentence: A snack can fill the gap before dinner.
examples.trans: 零食可以填补晚饭前的空档。

examples.sentence: Neighbours filled the gap when the night bus vanished.
examples.trans: 夜班车消失时，邻居填补了缺口。

examples.sentence: Unpaid hours fill the gap that posters will not fund.
examples.trans: 无偿时数填补海报不愿资助的缺口。

examples.sentence: She filled the gap in the timetable with sleep, not with more advice.
examples.trans: 她用睡眠而不是更多建议填补时间表的缺口。

examples.sentence: Statistics fill the gap with averages and lose the kitchen.
examples.trans: 统计用平均数填缺口，却弄丢了厨房。

examples.sentence: A wealthy street cannot fill the gap at the last bus stop with trees alone.
examples.trans: 富裕街道不能单靠树去填末班车站的缺口。

suffer from.usageZh: 动词短语：患、受……之苦 suffer from a cold / inequality。过去 suffered from。

examples.sentence: He suffered from a cold all week.
examples.trans: 他感冒了整整一周。

examples.sentence: The plants suffered from too little light.
examples.trans: 植物苦于光线太少。

examples.sentence: Households suffered from isolation that was called safety.
examples.trans: 家庭苦于被称为安全的隔离。

examples.sentence: They suffered from a timetable that praised love and stole sleep.
examples.trans: 他们苦于一张赞美爱却偷走睡眠的时间表。

examples.sentence: Cities suffer from night trucks and then blame loud families.
examples.trans: 城市苦于夜间卡车，却责备大声的家庭。

examples.sentence: A generation that suffered from locked doors still flinches at keys.
examples.trans: 受过锁门之苦的一代，仍会在钥匙声里一缩。

go together.usageZh: 动词短语：相配、一同出现 love and patience go together。进行时 going together。

examples.sentence: Milk and cookies go together.
examples.trans: 牛奶和饼干很配。

examples.sentence: Quiet and fairness go together in a small flat.
examples.trans: 小公寓里，安静和公平是一起的。

examples.sentence: Rights and night buses should go together.
examples.trans: 权利和夜班车应当一起出现。

examples.sentence: Shame and unpaid work often go together until someone names them.
examples.trans: 羞耻和无偿工作常一起出现，直到有人命名。

examples.sentence: Trust and kept promises go together; posters do not replace either.
examples.trans: 信任和守信的承诺一起走；海报替代不了任何一方。

examples.sentence: Wealth and trees go together on one street; equality has to catch the last bus.
examples.trans: 财富和树在一条街上作伴；平等得去赶末班车。

such as.usageZh: 短语：例如 such as A and B。后接名词/动名词，不直接接句子（句子用 for example）。

examples.sentence: Pack fruit such as apples.
examples.trans: 装些水果，比如苹果。

examples.sentence: Noises such as dripping taps become huge at night.
examples.trans: 夜里，水龙头滴水这类声音会变得巨大。

examples.sentence: Costs such as unpaid hours vanish from happy-family posters.
examples.trans: 无偿时数这类成本会从幸福家庭海报上消失。

examples.sentence: Policies such as rest days fail if workers cannot take them.
examples.trans: 休息日这类政策，若工人无法享用就会失败。

examples.sentence: Feelings such as jealousy often start as a map of missing rest.
examples.trans: 嫉妒这类感情，往往始于一张缺失休息的地图。

examples.sentence: Fixes such as slogans will not move a kitchen clock.
examples.trans: 口号这类对策，挪不动厨房的时钟。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：经历、结果、for/since，兼完成进行与被动完成
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect for experience, result, and unfinished time
grammar.usage: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词，连接过去与现在。They have gone through a hard year。标志词 already/yet/just/ever/never/for/since。对比一般过去：有具体过去时间用过去时。高中：完成进行 have been doing；被动 have been done。
forms: for + 时段 / since + 起点
have/has been + 过去分词（被动）
notes: He has 不是 He have。
短暂动词不宜接 for：改用 been here。
yesterday 用过去时。
since 接起点，for 接时段。
疑问 Have you ever...？

examples.en: Lina has washed the cups.
They have gone through a noisy month.
examples.cn: 他们经历了嘈杂的一个月。

examples.en: He has not slept yet.
The family has lived here since March.
examples.cn: 这家人从三月起住在这里。

examples.en: Unpaid hours have been ignored in the report.
examples.cn: 无偿时数在报告里一直被忽略。

examples.en: She has been waiting for the night bus since ten.
examples.cn: 她从十点起一直在等夜班车。

exercises.q: She ____ washed the cups.
I ____ finished dinner.
They have ____ the door.
选择正确句子。
We have not eaten ____.
Tom ____ (have) lost his key.
After she has ____ (eat), she will rest.
I have ____ (just / arrive).
现在完成由 have/has + 过去分词构成。
He have gone 正确。
碗是空的。她已经洗了。→ She ____ the cups.
否定：They have started. → They have not started ____.
After he ____ (finish), he will sleep.
改错：She have washed.
改错：He has go home.
They ____ through a hard month.
____ you ever waited for a night bus?
She has already ____ the apology.
We have lived here ____ 2019.
He has been tired ____ two weeks.
They have ____ (lock) the door.
I have not seen her ____ Monday.
____ you packed yet?
since 接起点，for 接时段。
He has arrived for two hours 很自然。
经历：They went through a hard year, and it still shows. → They ____ a hard year.
since：她从早上就在等。She ____ since morning.
already：We packed. → We have ____ packed.
改错：They has gone through a hard month.
exercises.answer: They have gone through a hard month.

exercises.q: 改错：He has arrived for two hours.
exercises.answer: He has been here for two hours.

exercises.q: Many families have ____ isolation that was called safety.
Once they have ____ an understanding, shouting drops.
She has never ____ a spare room.
____ having named the fear, they slept.
The statistics have ____ the kitchens.
When the rain has ____ (stop), we will walk.
She has ____ (be) waiting all week.
After they have eaten, they ____ (talk).
after having done 是书面结构。
有 yesterday 仍必须用现在完成。
once：You name the fear. Then you rest. → Once you ____ the fear, rest.
完成进行：她一上午都在等公交。She ____ for the bus all morning.
after having：They cooked. Then they talked. → After ____, they talked.
改错：They have suffer from isolation.
改错：The board has signed yesterday.
Unpaid hours have ____ in the report.
The family has not slept ____.
Inspectors have waited ____ dawn.
She has been ____ the night bus since ten.
Once the rest days have been ____, workers can actually rest.
After they have posted the hours, trust ____ (return).
The clause has ____ (remain) paper.
____ having sealed the door, they waited.
时间从句里的现在完成可指向将来已完成。
有明确过去时间仍必须用现在完成。
被动：They ignore unpaid hours. It still shows. → Unpaid hours ____ in the report.
完成进行：从十点起一直在等。She ____ since ten.
for/since：两周了。He has been tired ____ two weeks.
改错：Unpaid hours have ignored in the report.
exercises.answer: Unpaid hours have been ignored in the report.

exercises.q: 改错：They have gone through it last March.
exercises.answer: They went through it last March.

exercises.q: Night trucks have continued ____ two winters.
We have already ____ whose hours vanished.
Until the missing bus ____, isolation stood still.
They have been ____ the delay rather than naming it.
After having ____ the totals, they published a neat page.
Once enforcement has ____ (move), slogans mean something.
The street has not slept ____ night trucks arrived.
They have been ____ (share) the heavy hours.
lie 的过去分词是 lain。
after having done 不能带宾语。
once 被动：They fund rest days. Then people rest. → Once rest days ____, people can rest.
after having：They hid the delay. Then they lost trust. → After ____ the delay, they lost trust.
for：夜班车两冬没停。Night trucks have continued ____ two winters.
改错：We have named the hours last March.
exercises.answer: We named the hours last March.

exercises.q: 改错：Unpaid hours have being ignored.
A city has ____ isolation that it called safety.
Once access has been ____ as privilege, equality looks gated.
The footnote has ____ in the appendix for three drafts.
Inspectors have yet ____ real hours.
Having ____ the kitchens, they found the statistic was a room.
Until unpaid hours have been ____ (count), posters will lie.
The treaty has remained paper since rest days ____ (be) denied.
She has been ____ (mistake) silence for peace.
have yet to do 表示尚未发生。
Having done 的逻辑主语须是主句主语。
have yet to：休息日仍未兑现。Workers ____ rest days.
exercises.answer: have yet to be given / have yet to receive

exercises.q: after 被动：Society defers care. Later it pays. → After care ____, it still pays later.
分词：They named the kitchens. They saw the gap. → ____ the kitchens, they saw the gap.
改错：The footnote has laid in the appendix.
exercises.answer: The footnote has lain in the appendix.

exercises.q: 改错：Having named the kitchens, the statistic looked false. （悬垂）
exercises.answer: Having named the kitchens, they found the statistic looked false.

grammar.key: Modal Verb: 'ought to' / 情态动词 'ought to'
grammar.title: ought to / should / had better / must：义务强弱与 ought to have done
grammar.titleEn: Ought to versus should, had better, must, and perfect forms
grammar.usage: ought to 表义务或劝告，语气正式，接近 should。肯定 ought to do；否定 ought not to / oughtn't to；疑问 Ought we to...？对比：should 更常用；had better 更急切；must 最强；could/might 表建议更弱。高中：ought to have done 本该做而未做。
forms: 主语 + ought to + 原形
Ought + 主语 + to + 原形？
ought to have + 过去分词
notes: ought 后必须有 to，should 后无 to。
否定是 ought not to，不是 don't ought。
had better 后接原形，否定 had better not。
must 表强制，ought to 表道义。
对过去责备用 ought to have done。

examples.en: You ought to sleep now.
We ought to share the dishes.
You ought not to shout after ten.
They ought to have funded the night bus.
You had better eat before you argue.
A city ought to count unpaid hours.
examples.cn: 一座城市应当计算无偿时数。

exercises.q: You ____ to wash your cup.
We ought ____ share.
You should ____ now.
选择正确句子。
You ____ better wait.
She ought to ____ (lock) the door.
You should not ____ (shout).
We ____ to help.
ought 后面要有 to。
You ought rest 正确。
用 ought to：You should sleep. → You ____ sleep.
用 should：You ought to wait. → You ____ wait.
had better：You ought to eat first. → You ____ eat first.
改错：You ought rest now.
改错：You don't ought to shout.
They ought ____ the chores.
You ought not ____ after ten.
____ we to wait?
You had better not ____ the baby.
We ____ keep the promise.
He ought to ____ (apologise).
You had better ____ (eat) first.
They ought not to ____ (judge) by noise.
had better 后不加 to。
Ought we to... 是可能的疑问形式。
否定：You ought to shout. → You ____ shout after ten.
疑问：We ought to wait. → ____ we to wait?
must 更强：You ought to lock it. （规定）→ You ____ lock it.
改错：You had better to eat.
改错：Ought we wait?
Night-shift parents ought to ____ real rest days.
You ____ have named the unpaid hours sooner.
They should not have ____ the delay.
You might ____ ask who cooked.
It's time we ____ the dishes.
They ought to have ____ (fund) the bus.
You should have ____ (sleep) before the argument.
We ought to ____ (be) honest about hours.
ought to have done 表示过去该做未做。
It's time 后可用过去式表示现在该做。
过去责备：They didn't fund the bus. → They ____ the bus.
exercises.answer: ought to have funded / should have funded

exercises.q: 被动：Someone ought to give rest days. → Rest days ought to ____.
It's time：We should share now. → It's time we ____.
改错：They ought have funded it.
exercises.answer: They ought to have funded it.

exercises.q: 改错：It's time we share the dishes. （更正式虚拟）
exercises.answer: It's time we shared the dishes.

exercises.q: A city ought to ____ unpaid hours.
Rest days ought to have been ____.
You ____ well share the night feeds.
The board ought not to ____ isolation 'safety' without hours.
Workers had better ____ the extra shift until it is paid.
Governments ought to have ____ (name) the kitchens.
Equality should not ____ (be) a poster only.
They ought to ____ (be) counting interrupted sleep.
情态 + 被动：ought to be done / ought to have been done。
might as well 表示勉强建议。
被动完成：They didn't fund rest days. → Rest days ____.
might well：Ask who cooked. → You ____ ask who cooked.
had better 否定：Take the unpaid shift. （劝阻）→ You ____ the unpaid shift.
改错：Rest days ought to have funded.
exercises.answer: Rest days ought to have been funded.

exercises.q: 改错：You might well to ask.
Night trucks ought to ____ before four.
The report ought not to have ____ kitchens into averages.
One ____ to treat rest as infrastructure.
They had better ____ whose hours the slogan costs.
Must we ____ isolation as safety?
Slogans ought to ____ (come) with funded hours.
They should never have ____ (call) unpaid work helping out.
The city had better ____ (count) the last bus.
one ought to 是正式的普遍义务。
must 的否定 mustn't 是禁止，needn't 是不必。
过去不该：They flattened kitchens into averages. → The report ____ kitchens into averages.
普遍义务：Treat rest as infrastructure. → One ____ rest as infrastructure.
needn't：Must we wait? 若不必 → We ____ wait.
改错：One ought treat rest as infrastructure.
exercises.answer: One ought to treat rest as infrastructure.

exercises.q: 改错：They ought not have flattened kitchens.
exercises.answer: They ought not to have flattened kitchens.

exercises.q: A wealthy city ought to ____ the last bus stop before it praises trees.
Isolation ought never to have been ____ as a public service.
One ought not to ____ equality that trips on a kitchen clock.
Policymakers might ____ start with who washes up.
Had they counted hours, they ____ to have written a different poster.
Care ought to have been ____ (fund) when it was praised.
A government ought to ____ (be) buying hours back.
They should not have ____ (shame) the depressed.
ought to 可与完成被动叠用表达制度性失职。
might as well 总是表示过去虚拟。
制度失职：They praised care and did not fund it. → Care ____ when it was praised.
might as well：从洗碗的人问起。→ Policymakers ____ start with who washes up.
one ought not：不要宣布会被厨房时钟绊倒的平等。→ One ____ equality that trips on a kitchen clock.
改错：Isolation ought never have been sold as a public service.
exercises.answer: Isolation ought never to have been sold as a public service.

exercises.q: 改错：One ought not declare equality that cannot survive a clock.
exercises.answer: One ought not to declare equality that cannot survive a clock.

grammar.key: Comparative Structure: 'more and more' / 比较结构: '越来越...'
grammar.title: 叠用比较级 more and more / -er and -er，兼 fewer/less
grammar.titleEn: Double comparatives for a single increasing trend
grammar.usage: 叠用比较级表单一趋势：noisier and noisier / more and more tired。对比 the more..., the more... 连接两个变化。less and less 递减。fewer and fewer + 可数。
notes: 不要 more and more louder。
people 用 more and more people。
fewer 接可数。
可与 become/get 连用。
不要和 the more 句型零件混用。

examples.en: The house got noisier and noisier.
She became more and more tired.
Fewer and fewer buses came after nine.
Unpaid hours look more and more like love.
examples.cn: 无偿时数越来越像被叫做爱。

examples.en: Trust grew thinner and thinner.
The statistic looked less and less like a kitchen.
examples.cn: 这统计越来越不像厨房。

exercises.q: The bag is getting ____.
She is becoming ____ tired.
Days are getting ____.
选择正确句子。
options: It is getting colder and colder.
It gets more and more colder.
It is getting cold and colderest.
exercises.answer: It is getting colder and colder.

exercises.q: He feels ____ hungry.
The puppy is growing ____ (big).
The wait is becoming more and more ____ (long).
Nights are getting ____ (dark).
more and more louder 正确。
单音节常用 -er and -er。
汤越来越稠。→ The soup is getting ____.
她越来越累。→ She is becoming ____ tired.
递减：He is more and more sure. → He is ____ sure.
改错：It is getting more and more colder.
exercises.answer: It is getting colder and colder.

exercises.q: 改错：The days are longer and more longer.
exercises.answer: The days are getting longer and longer.

exercises.q: Indoor months became ____.
____ people waited for the night bus.
He made ____ mistakes after rest.
Her voice became ____.
The house grew ____ after ten.
Shifts are becoming more and more ____ (long).
Fewer and fewer buses ____ (come) after nine.
The wait felt ____ (long).
fewer and fewer 接可数复数。
more and more person 正确。
错误减少。→ She makes ____ mistakes.
耐心减少。→ He has ____ patience.
越来越多家庭等夜班车。→ ____ families wait for the night bus.
改错：More and more person wait.
改错：He made less and less mistakes.
exercises.answer: He made fewer and fewer mistakes.

exercises.q: Unpaid hours look ____ like love.
Spare rooms become ____.
The melody of keys grew ____.
His explanations became ____.
____ contact filled the locked months.
Private rest is becoming ____ (hard) to buy.
The city feels ____ (loud) at four.
She grew ____ (patient) with the dripping.
get/become/grow 常接叠用比较级。
less and less 不能修饰形容词。
知道钥匙声越来越熟。→ The key sound became ____.
可负担的休息越来越少。→ Rest is becoming ____.
网上视频越来越多。→ There are ____ videos.
改错：It became more and more easier.
改错：Less and less people wait. （people 可数）
Public support grew ____ after lights stayed broken.
Unpaid internships look ____ exclusive.
The averages look ____ neat.
____ villages vanished from the bus map.
Night rooms are getting ____.
Access is becoming ____ (gate).
Inspectors seem ____ (welcome).
Kitchens are getting ____ (tired).
分词形容词可用 more and more。
可与 the more 句型混用零件。
信任变薄。→ Trust is growing ____.
exercises.answer: thinner and thinner / less and less

exercises.q: 树荫越来越像装饰。→ Shade is treated ____ as decoration.
安静村子从地图消失。→ ____ quiet villages remain.
改错：The totals look more and more neater.
exercises.answer: The totals look neater and neater.

exercises.q: 改错：More and more village disappeared.
Rents climb ____ while wages freeze.
Slogans achieve ____ without funded hours.
Rounded figures look ____ suspicious.
People who cannot reschedule become ____ invisible.
Curiosity dies ____ when love means dishes.
Posters look ____ (hollow) without hours.
The street grows ____ (sleepless).
Raw hours seem ____ (optional) in the draft.
look/seem 可接叠用比较级。
faster 必须改 more and more fast。
延误越来越像和平。→ Delay looks ____ like peace.
账单变大。→ The bill is getting ____.
条约越来越不像活的法律。→ The treaty looks ____ like living law.
改错：Rents climb more and more higher.
改错：Slogans achieve fewer and fewer.
A model unmoored from kitchens looks ____ like care.
Excellence as unpaid repetition becomes ____ to believe.
Footnotes sink ____ into appendices.
____ of what we call love is unnamed hours.
Private luck looks ____ like talent.
Inspectors appear ____ (ceremonial).
The last-bus test fits ____ (tightly).
exercises.answer: more and more tightly / tighter and tighter

exercises.q: Care deferred returns ____ (harsh).
more and more of + 抽象名词合法。
书面语禁用 more and more。
用 increasingly：Access looks more and more like privilege. → Access looks ____ like privilege.
脚注更深。→ The footnote sinks ____.
活着的条款越来越少。→ ____ living clauses remain.
改错：It looks more and more less like care.
exercises.answer: It looks less and less like care.

exercises.q: 改错：Harder and more harder to believe.

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Simple Past) / 被动语态 (一般过去时)
grammar.title: 一般过去时被动 was/were + 过去分词，兼过去完成被动与 It was said that
grammar.titleEn: Past simple passive and related past passives
grammar.usage: 一般过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词，强调承受者。The door was locked. 施动者用 by。否定 was not done。情态过去 could be done。高中：It was said that...；过去完成被动 had been done。
forms: Was/Were + 主语 + 过去分词？
notes: 主语是承受者。
by 短语可省略。
不规则动词要用过去分词 written/done/gone。
were 接复数。
有具体过去时间仍用过去被动，不用现在完成被动。

examples.en: The door was locked at nine.
The cups were washed by Lina.
The extra shift was not paid.
The rest days were declared, then ignored.
examples.cn: 休息日被宣布，然后被忽略。

examples.en: The report was written without kitchens.
Unpaid hours had been hidden before the vote.
examples.cn: 投票前无偿时数已被藏起。

exercises.q: The door ____ locked.
The cups ____ washed.
The cake was ____ by Mum.
选择正确句子。
The letter ____ not sent.
The fish ____ (be) eaten.
The bags were ____ (pack).
____ the door locked?
过去被动用 was/were + 过去分词。
The cups was washed 正确。
主动：Lina washed the cups. → The cups ____ by Lina.
主动：Someone locked the door. → The door ____.
否定：The letter was sent. → The letter ____ sent.
改错：The door were locked.
改错：The cake was make by Mum.
exercises.answer: The cake was made by Mum.

exercises.q: The apology was ____ twice.
Quiet hours ____ kept after ten.
The night bus was not ____.
____ the rest days declared on Friday?
The dishes were done ____ Omar.
The window was ____ (break) in the storm.
Two chairs ____ (be) moved.
The message was not ____ (send).
by 引出施动者。
written 是 write 的过去分词。
主动：Omar did the dishes. → The dishes ____ by Omar.
主动：They declared rest days. → Rest days ____.
疑问：The bus was funded. → ____ the bus funded?
改错：The apology was wrote twice.
改错：Quiet hours was kept.
Isolation was ____ safety.
The unpaid hours were ____ from the poster.
A spare room was never ____.
____ the statistics flattened on purpose?
The key was ____ in the door all night.
The visit was ____ (cancel).
Two nights were ____ (steal) by trucks.
The joke was not ____ (mean) kindly.
被动可带主语补足语：was called safety。
过去被动不能带 yesterday。
主动：They called isolation safety. → Isolation ____ safety.
主动：Trucks stole two nights. → Two nights ____ by trucks.
never：Nobody offered a spare room. → A spare room ____.
改错：Isolation was call safety.
改错：Two nights was stolen.
Unpaid hours were ____ in the vote.
The night bus was ____ as optional.
Rest days had been ____ before the cameras arrived.
It was said that the house was ____.
The kitchens were not ____ in the average.
The delay was ____ (name) too late.
A fair timetable had been ____ (ask) for.
It was reported that wages ____ (freeze).
过去完成被动 had been done 表过去的过去。
It was said that 是常见形式主语被动。
过去的过去：They promised rest days. Then cameras came. → Rest days ____ before the cameras arrived.
形式主语：People said the house was peaceful. → It ____ that the house was peaceful.
主动：Nobody counted kitchens. → Kitchens ____.
改错：Unpaid hours were hide in the vote.
exercises.answer: Unpaid hours were hidden in the vote.

exercises.q: 改错：Rest days had been promise.
Shade was ____ as decoration.
The last bus was ____ from the map.
Interrupted sleep had been ____ as personality.
It was claimed that equality ____ on paper.
Night trucks were not ____ until four.
The quieter villages were ____ (skip).
A living wage had been ____ (refuse).
It was announced that rest days ____ (grant).
claimed/said/announced 常接 that 从句被动。
by 短语在施动者不重要时可省。
主动：They treated shade as decoration. → Shade ____ as decoration.
过去的过去：They refused a living wage. Then the vote happened. → A living wage ____ before the vote.
It was claimed：People claimed equality was achieved. → It ____ that equality was achieved.
改错：The last bus was remove from the map.
exercises.answer: The last bus was removed from the map.

exercises.q: 改错：Interrupted sleep had been sell as personality.
exercises.answer: Interrupted sleep had been sold as personality.

exercises.q: Care was ____ in speeches and starved in budgets.
The depressed were ____ for a waiting list.
Unnamed contributions had been ____ into GDP.
It was insisted that isolation ____ safety.
Footnotes were ____ where readers would not look.
Equality was ____ (declare) and then trip-tested by a clock. 用 declared。
The last bus had been ____ (cut) before the trees were praised.
It was whispered that the average ____ (build) without kitchens.
被动不消除施动责任，只是改变信息焦点。
过去完成被动标志在另一过去动作之前完成。
反讽：They praised care in speeches. → Care ____ in speeches.
过去的过去：They cut the last bus. Then they praised trees. → The last bus ____ before the trees were praised.
It was insisted：People insisted isolation was safety. → It ____ that isolation was safety.
改错：The depressed were shame for a waiting list.
exercises.answer: The depressed were shamed for a waiting list.

exercises.q: 改错：Footnotes were bury in the appendix.
exercises.answer: Footnotes were buried in the appendix.

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Reason: 'Due to' / 原因状语从句: 'Due to'
grammar.title: due to / because / because of / owing to / since / as / thanks to
grammar.titleEn: Reason markers: due to, because, owing to, thanks to
grammar.usage: due to 表原因，后接名词/动名词，多作表语或定语：The delay was due to rain. 对比 because + 从句；because of / owing to / on account of + 名词；since/as 连词。高中：owing to 更正式；thanks to 偏正面。
forms: be due to + 名词/动名词
because of / owing to + 名词
notes: due to 后不直接接完整句子。
because 接句子，because of 接名词。
句首 Due to 有人认为不规范，可用 Owing to。
thanks to 不宜用于灾难原因。
for 也可表原因，但更短。

examples.en: The delay was due to rain.
We stayed because the bus was late.
examples.cn: 我们留下是因为车晚点了。

examples.en: The argument started because of tiredness.
Owing to the locked months, tempers shortened.
examples.cn: 由于锁门的月份，脾气变短了。

examples.en: The extra cost was due to unpaid hours.
examples.cn: 额外成本来自无偿时数。

examples.en: Thanks to neighbours, the baby slept.

exercises.q: The delay was ____ rain.
We waited ____ the rain was heavy.
He stayed home ____ a cold.
选择正确句子。
options: The mess was due to the wind.
The mess was due the wind.
The mess was because the wind.
The mess due to wind was.
exercises.answer: The mess was due to the wind.

exercises.q: She smiled ____ the soup.
The noise was due to ____ (truck).
We left because it ____ (rain).
He slept ____ of tiredness.
due to 后接名词。
because of 后接完整句子。
用 due to：The delay happened because of rain. → The delay was ____ rain.
用 because：We stayed due to rain. → We stayed ____ it was raining.
because of：She smiled due to the soup. → She smiled ____ the soup.
改错：The delay was due rain.
exercises.answer: The delay was due to rain.

exercises.q: 改错：We waited because of it was raining.
exercises.answer: We waited because it was raining.

exercises.q: The argument was due to ____.
They whispered ____ the baby was asleep.
Owing ____ the storm, the hall opened.
The closed lift caused delay ____ repairs.
____ the noise, we could not sleep.
The fight was due to ____ (lack) of sleep.
We stopped because the ice ____ (look) thin.
Owing to the rain, the match ____ (be) cancelled.
owing to 接近 due to，稍正式。
Due to 后面可以直接接 they were tired。
owing to：因为暴风雨，礼堂开放。→ ____ the storm, the hall opened.
because：争吵因为他们累了。→ The argument started ____ they were tired.
due to：延误因为维修。→ The delay was ____ repairs.
改错：The argument was due to they were tired.
exercises.answer: The argument was due to tiredness. / The argument started because they were tired.

exercises.q: 改错：Owing the storm, the hall opened.
exercises.answer: Owing to the storm, the hall opened.

exercises.q: Isolation was due to ____ doors, not to lack of love.
Tempers shortened since nobody ____.
The extra cost was due to unpaid hours ____ nobody counted.
Thanks ____ neighbours, the baby slept.
On account ____ the late bus, she missed dinner.
The breakup was due to ____ (run) out of hours.
As the trucks returned, the street ____ (wake).
Because of ____ (interrupt) sleep, patience thinned.
thanks to 多用于正面原因。
since/as 可引导原因从句。
动名词：The breakup happened because they ran out of hours. → The breakup was due to ____ out of hours.
thanks to：邻居帮忙，宝宝睡着了。→ ____ neighbours, the baby slept.
on account of：因为晚班车。→ She missed dinner ____ the late bus.
改错：Thanks to the flood, the hall collapsed. （灾难不宜 thanks to）
exercises.answer: Because of / Owing to / Due to the flood, the hall collapsed.

exercises.q: 改错：The extra cost was due to nobody counted.
exercises.answer: The extra cost was due to unpaid hours that nobody counted.

exercises.q: The thin statistic was due to kitchens ____ flattened.
Wages froze ____ rents kept climbing.
The gap was due to hours ____ nobody funded.
Owing to ____ sleep, patience thinned.
____ to neighbours, the night feed was shared.
The delay was due to the night bus ____ (vanish).
Since rest days were paper, workers ____ (keep) working.
The cost was ____ to unpaid hours.
due to + sb/sth doing 是复合结构。
as 只能表时间，不能表原因。
复合：The statistic was thin because kitchens were flattened. → The statistic was due to kitchens ____ flattened.
as 原因：Rents climbed and wages froze together in time/cause. → Wages froze ____ rents kept climbing.
thanks to 正面：Neighbours helped. → ____ neighbours, the night feed was shared.
改错：The statistic was due to kitchens were flattened.
exercises.answer: The statistic was due to kitchens being flattened.

exercises.q: 改错：Wages froze because of rents kept climbing.
exercises.answer: Wages froze because rents kept climbing.

exercises.q: The sleepless street was due to trucks ____ at four.
Tempers shortened ____ nobody named the hours.
On account of ____ maps, villages vanished.
The neat average was due to kitchens ____ counted.
____ the last bus was cut, trees were praised.
The anger was due to unpaid hours ____ (pile) up.
Since the slogan ignored dishes, trust ____ (thin).
The gap was ____ to a missing night bus.
not being counted 是合法的否定动名词。
owing to 后面接完整句子。
动名词：Trucks returned at four, so the street was sleepless. → The street was due to trucks ____ at four.
because：没人点名时数，脾气变短。→ Tempers shortened ____ nobody named the hours.
due to：缺口来自缺失的夜班车。→ The gap was ____ a missing night bus.
改错：The street was due to trucks returned at four.
exercises.answer: The street was due to trucks returning at four.

exercises.q: 改错：On account of maps were flattened, villages vanished.
exercises.answer: On account of flattened maps, villages vanished.

exercises.q: The thin GDP story was due to unnamed contributions ____ folded away.
Care starved ____ it was only praised.
Owing to kitchen ____, paper equality tripped.
The waiting list was due to care ____ funded.
____ to a cousin's spare room, isolation eased.
The bill was due to care ____ (defer) for a decade.
Since equality tripped on a clock, speeches ____ (thin).
The crisis was ____ to unnamed hours.
制度性原因也可以用 due to + 抽象名词。
thanks to 适合灾难伤亡。
复合：Contributions were folded away, so the GDP story was thin. → The story was due to contributions ____ folded away.
because：只被赞美所以照护饥饿。→ Care starved ____ it was only praised.
thanks to：多亏多余房间。→ ____ a cousin's spare room, isolation eased.
改错：Care starved because of it was only praised.
exercises.answer: Care starved because it was only praised.

exercises.q: 改错：The waiting list was due to care not be funded.
exercises.answer: The waiting list was due to care not being funded.

grammar.key: Comparative Structure 'as...as...' / 同级比较结构 'as...as...'
grammar.title: 同级比较 as...as / not so...as / as many/much / 倍数
grammar.titleEn: As...as comparatives, including negatives and multiples
grammar.usage: 同级比较 as + adj/adv + as。否定 not as/so ... as。as many as + 可数；as much as + 不可数。the same as。as...as possible / as...as one can。高中：as adj a n as；倍数：twice as ... as。
notes: 肯定用 as...as，不用 so...as（否定可用 so）。
后一个 as 不可丢。
many 接可数，much 接不可数。
不要 as more tall as。
twice as expensive as，不是 twice more expensive as（后者也有人说，考场慎用）。

examples.en: Tom is as tall as his brother.
This cup is not as clean as that one.
examples.cn: 这只杯子没有那只要干净。

examples.en: Share the fruit as equally as you can.
examples.cn: 尽你所能把水果分得一样。

examples.en: No two nights are as equal as a poster claims.
examples.cn: 没有两个夜晚像海报说的那样平等。

examples.en: Rest is not as cheap as slogans suggest.
examples.cn: 休息并不像口号说的那么便宜。

examples.en: A spare room is twice as rare as a kind word.
examples.cn: 空房比一句好话稀有一倍。

exercises.q: Tom is ____ tall as Ben.
This bag is not ____ heavy as that one.
She runs as ____ as a deer.
选择正确句子。
options: He is as kind as his aunt.
He is as kinder as his aunt.
He is as kind than his aunt.
He is more kind as his aunt.
exercises.answer: He is as kind as his aunt.

exercises.q: Take as ____ apples as you need.
Lina is as ____ (quiet) as a cat.
This tea is not as ____ (hot) as that.
Pick as ____ (much) rice as you can.
as...as 中间用原级。
He is as taller as Ben 正确。
同级：Tom and Ben are equally tall. → Tom is ____ Ben.
否定：This cup is dirtier. → This cup is not ____ that one.
many：尽可能多拿苹果。→ Take ____ apples as you need.
改错：He is as taller as Ben.
exercises.answer: He is as tall as Ben.

exercises.q: 改错：Take as much apples as you need.
exercises.answer: Take as many apples as you need.

exercises.q: Their shifts are not as ____ as the poster.
She spoke as ____ as she could.
We have as ____ chairs as people.
This soup is the same ____ Grandma's.
He is not so tired ____ she is.
Be as ____ (fair) as the table.
They waited as ____ (long) as the bus allowed.
There is not as ____ (much) quiet as we need.
the same as 是同级结构。
not so...as 只能用于肯定句。
the same：这汤和奶奶的一样。→ This soup is ____ Grandma's.
副词：尽量轻声。→ She spoke ____ she could.
not so：他没她那么累。→ He is not so tired ____ she is.
改错：This soup is the same like Grandma's.
exercises.answer: This soup is the same as Grandma's.

exercises.q: 改错：She spoke as softer as she could.
exercises.answer: She spoke as softly as she could.

exercises.q: No two nights are as ____ as a poster claims.
They split hours as ____ as two shifts allow.
There are not as ____ spare rooms as locked months.
Sleep is not so cheap ____ slogans suggest.
Be as equal ____ you can.
Share as ____ (equal) as two different nights allow.
They kept as ____ (little) noise as possible.
A kind word is not as ____ (rare) as a spare room.
as...as possible 等于 as...as one can。
as many as 接不可数名词。
课文：海报声称夜晚平等。→ No two nights are ____ a poster claims.
as possible：尽量少噪声。→ Keep ____ noise as possible.
not so：睡眠不像口号那么便宜。→ Sleep is not so cheap ____ slogans suggest.
改错：No two nights are as equally as a poster claims. （要形容词）
exercises.answer: No two nights are as equal as a poster claims.

exercises.q: 改错：There are not as much spare rooms.
exercises.answer: There are not as many spare rooms.

exercises.q: Rest is not as ____ as slogans suggest.
A spare room is twice as ____ as a kind word.
Unpaid hours are not so invisible ____ kitchens are.
Keep the chairs as ____ as the speeches.
They did as ____ unpaid work as the poster hid.
A night bus is as ____ (necessary) as a slogan.
There is not as ____ (much) funded care as praise.
Twice as ____ (many) households lacked a spare room.
倍数 + as ... as 是标准同级。
twice more...as 比 twice as 更稳妥。
倍数：空房比好话稀有一倍。→ A spare room is ____ a kind word.
not as：休息不像口号便宜。→ Rest is ____ slogans suggest.
much：海报藏了同样多的无偿工作。→ They did ____ unpaid work as the poster hid.
改错：A spare room is twice more rare as a kind word.
exercises.answer: A spare room is twice as rare as a kind word.

exercises.q: 改错：They did as many unpaid work.
exercises.answer: They did as much unpaid work.

exercises.q: Paper equality is not as ____ as a last bus.
Interrupted sleep is three times as ____ as a raised voice.
Maps are not so honest ____ they look neat.
Treat hours as ____ as money.
There were as ____ vanished villages as new trees.
A kitchen clock is as ____ (strict) as a court.
They published as ____ (little) raw hours as they could hide.
Wages are not as ____ (mobile) as rents.
as adj a n as：as strict a clock as 是正式变体。
as carefully as 中 carefully 是副词。
倍数：被打断的睡眠比嗓门代价高三倍。→ Interrupted sleep is ____ a raised voice.
副词：对待时数要像对待钱一样小心。→ Treat hours ____ money.
not so：地图整齐不等于诚实。→ Maps are not so honest ____ they look neat.
改错：Treat hours as careful as money.
exercises.answer: Treat hours as carefully as money.

exercises.q: 改错：There were as much vanished villages.
exercises.answer: There were as many vanished villages.

exercises.q: A right on paper is not as ____ as a funded hour.
Silence can be as ____ as a slammed door.
GDP is not so complete ____ kitchens are missing.
Count contributions as ____ as famous names.
There is as ____ unnamed labour as named growth.
A last bus is as ____ (political) as a speech.
They hid as ____ (many) hours as the average could bear.
Equality is not as ____ (portable) as ink.
比喻性 as...as 仍用原级。
as fully as 修饰动词 count。
比喻：沉默可以和摔门一样响。→ Silence can be ____ a slammed door.
much：未命名劳动和点名增长一样多。→ There is ____ unnamed labour as named growth.
not so：厨房缺失时 GDP 并不完整。→ GDP is not so complete ____ kitchens are missing.
改错：Silence can be as louder as a slammed door.
exercises.answer: Silence can be as loud as a slammed door.

exercises.q: 改错：Count contributions as full as famous names.
exercises.answer: Count contributions as fully as famous names.

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Time introduced by 'when' / 由 'when' 引导的时间状语从句
grammar.title: when / while / as / until / as soon as，兼 hardly...when 与关系副词 when
grammar.titleEn: Time clauses with when and related conjunctions
grammar.usage: when 引导时间状语从句。主句将来时，从句用现在时：When the bus comes, we will go。when 也可表“正在那时”。对比 while（同时进行）、as（一边）、before/after/until/as soon as。高中：when 还可作关系副词；hardly...when。
forms: When + 现在时, 主句 will
while / as / before / after / until / as soon as
notes: 时间从句不用 will。
when 可接点时间，while 多接持续。
as soon as 更强调立刻。
until 表持续到某点。
When I was a child 用过去时。

examples.en: When the soup is hot, eat slowly.
Call me when the bus arrives.
When the argument ended, they opened the windows.
examples.cn: 争吵结束时，他们打开了窗。

examples.en: When unpaid hours pile up, tempers shorten.
examples.cn: 无偿时数堆积时，脾气变短。

examples.en: Hardly had they slept when the trucks returned.
examples.cn: 他们刚睡，卡车就回来了。

examples.en: The hour when the last bus leaves decides who can work.
examples.cn: 末班车离开的那个小时，决定谁能工作。

exercises.q: ____ the soup is hot, wait.
We will go when the bus ____.
Call me ____ you arrive.
